Introduction

Amy Lee, known professionally as Ailee, is a Korean-American singer & songwriter under A2Z Entertainment. Ailee is considered as one of the most talented vocalists in Korea, even being referred to as ‘the Beyoncé of Korea’. She is well-recognized for her powerful voice and extensive vocal range of G3-E5.

Born in Denver, Colorado, Ailee grew up enjoying popular Korean music, often singing songs by S.E.S, Fin.K.L, Lee Hyo-ri & 2NE1, even watching Inkigayo and Music Bank episodes. She has studied ballet, jazz, and hip-hop dance as well as piano, drums, djembe, and flute.

During her school years, Ailee won awards in the New Jersey Choir Contest. In 2006 she formed a band and performed on college events and underground events, even posting videos on YouTube. She also appeared in The Maury Show in 2008 and sang Rihanna's 'Unfaithful’, placing second. On September 13, 2011, she appeared as a trainee on the MBC Chuseok special pilot program ‘Singer and Trainee’ and won.

Ailee made her debut on February 9, 2012 with the single "Heaven”. The song peaked at number three on the Gaon Digital Charts, and swept all the rookie awards at the year-end award shows.

On October 16, 2012, Ailee released her debut EP Invitation, with the title track "I Will Show You”, for which she earned her first win on Music Bank.

Ailee is a recipient of numerous awards including the Mnet America Rising Star Award, a special award presented by Mnet America at the pre-show of 55th Grammy Awards, which she attended.

Her 2017 single, "I Will Go to You Like the First Snow” which was recorded for the soundtrack of the hit series Guardian: The Lonely and Great God (2016) was the most digitally successful song of that year, becoming the best-selling soundtrack in South Korea. The same year, she made her American debut with the single "Fall Back" under the stage name A.Leean.

Ailee confirmed her relationship with actor-turned-entrepreneur Choi Si-hun in 2024. The couple married in a star-studded ceremony on April 20, 2025.
